verdict.rationale: New Relic exposes NerdGraph, a documented GraphQL API for querying and configuring data, complete with an interactive API explorer, plus an official CLI (newrelic-cli) for managing entities, tags, and deployments — giving AI-native users multiple documented, scriptable interfaces to drive the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of API robustness and explicit versioning/rate-limit docs (the OpenAPI probe 404s, though NerdGraph's own GraphQL schema/explorer substitutes for that).
